Fire and forget — do not retry, and do not block the gesture on the response. Carries no URL, host, or carousel index by design: the gesture itself is the payload, and the server derives the social source from the stored post URL. Unknown unit ids are recorded rather than rejected, so a client never has to reconcile ids before reporting.
